description: This file defines the EmploymentStatus entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It models employment status data, including properties such as id and name, and manages a collection of associated Employee entities. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: EmploymentStatus
classes.description: Entity class representing employment status, with properties for id, name, and associated employees, mapped to the 'ohrm_employment_status' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the employment status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the employment status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the employment status.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the employment status.

methods.name: getEmployees
methods.description: Returns a collection of Employee entities associated with this employment status.

methods.name: setEmployees
methods.description: Assigns a collection of Employee entities to this employment status.
